solver.name: SU2
solver.physics: EULER (inviscid), ROE scheme, MUSCL + VENKATAKRISHNAN limiter, CFL 10
solver.note: Euler contains no viscosity; the whole computation is an inviscid pressure-only solve and can never be described as an aircraft fuel-burn fidelity claim

frozen_conditions.alpha_note: AoA was taken from the archived RCAIDE LF baseline alpha_end; it is a documented choice, not an independently optimised or trimmed condition

wedge_benchmark.purpose: SU2 Euler verification against oblique-shock theory before using the wing mesh

acceptance.wall_pressure_ratio_note: pressure ratio within 0.4% on the wall

wedge_benchmark.why: the wall pressure ratio matches theory to -0.42%, but the measured shock angle is 40.9-41.4 deg in the far field (origin fit 41.9 deg) versus the theoretical 39.31 deg: the deviation of +1.6 to +2.1 deg exceeds the pre-declared 1 deg tolerance. A single coarse mesh cannot separate discretisation error from the sharp-tip singularity, so the wedge benchmark is PARTIAL, not PASS.
wedge_benchmark.convergence_note: rms[Rho] plateaued at -1.905 and mesh refinement (HFS-00R) was not run because the SU2 budget slot was consumed by mesh-format failures

HFS-01.why: SU2 rejected the ASCII mesh because the boundary faces were written with VTK type 3 (line) instead of 5 (triangle) - a harness defect in our own converter, fixed afterwards; the failing process still counts as one numerical-analysis start per D-12D-002

residual.note: rms[Rho] plateaus near 1e-1 because of the sharp leading-edge singularity; the integrated forces are nevertheless stationary to 1e-9 relative over the last 200 iterations (see force_stability_last_200)

pressure_integration_cross_check.check_note: wind-axis drag/lift from the wall pressure integration; CD = (Fx cos a + Fz sin a)/(q Sref), CL = (-Fx sin a + Fz cos a)/(q Sref), AoA about +y. Sign convention calibrated so CD/CL match the SU2 history.

residual.note: rms[Rho] plateaus near 1e-1 because of the sharp leading-edge singularity; the integrated forces are nevertheless stationary to 1e-9 relative over the last 200 iterations (see force_stability_last_200)

pressure_integration_cross_check.check_note: wind-axis drag/lift from the wall pressure integration; CD = (Fx cos a + Fz sin a)/(q Sref), CL = (-Fx sin a + Fz cos a)/(q Sref), AoA about +y. Sign convention calibrated so CD/CL match the SU2 history.

mesh_summary.geometry: isolated 12D main wing (span 25.604638 m, Sref 358.25 m2, NACA65-203 sections)
mesh_summary.note: mesh volumes by the divergence theorem converge monotonically to the analytic wing volume; the wall area is 0.66-0.72% above the analytic wetted area, which is the expected faceting bias of a tetrahedral surface mesh

CD.note: only two grids exist, so the observed order cannot be measured; the two assumed orders bracket the estimate, they do not prove it

CL.note: only two grids exist, so the observed order cannot be measured; the two assumed orders bracket the estimate, they do not prove it

CMy.note: only two grids exist, so the observed order cannot be measured; the two assumed orders bracket the estimate, they do not prove it

mesh_convergence.note: HFS-01 (coarse level) failed at the mesh-format stage and consumed its budget slot, so only two levels exist; a three-level verification is NOT available and no order of accuracy can be claimed

not_run.HFS-00R: wedge mesh-refinement verification - SU2 category cap (6) exhausted
not_run.HFS-04: W10 tip_twist +2 deg Euler recompute - SU2 category cap (6) exhausted
not_run.why: D-12D-002 forbids raising a category cap; the failures above consumed slots that otherwise would have been available for these runs

budget.note: HFS-SETUP-01 (invalid CONV_CRITERIA key), HFS-SETUP-02 (no MARKER_MONITORING, forces zero), HFS-00 wedge, HFS-01 mesh-format failure, HFS-02 medium, HFS-03 fine

what_is_supported: SU2 8.5.0 Euler runs on this machine with MS-MPI and converges the integrated forces of an isolated 12D main wing at Mach 2.02
two mesh levels give a measured grid sensitivity of the Euler force coefficients
the wall-pressure integration reproduces the solver's own CD/CL to machine precision, so the post-processing chain is verified
the wedge benchmark reproduces the wall pressure ratio to 0.4%
what_is_not_supported: no three-level grid convergence and no order-of-accuracy estimate
the residual plateau at rms[Rho] ~ 1e-1 means the requested convergence level was never reached; force stationarity is the only convergence evidence
Euler is inviscid: no friction drag, so no high-fidelity aircraft drag or fuel claim
the wing alone is modelled: no fuselage, vertical tail, nacelles or interference
the wedge shock angle misses the pre-declared 1 deg tolerance by 1.6-2.1 deg
no CL-matched comparison with the LF chain exists (Euler CL 0.0928 vs mission CL 0.1334)
